thread:
sam_partnerships: Heads up — ArmCloud APAC PO keeps failing ingestion due to vendor entity mismatch. Customer wants deployment this week, finance flagged it. Can we triage? :eyes:

anita_finance: What's the PO id and the marketplace rejection message? I'll check procurements rules.

marketplace-bot: PO ingestion failed: error_code=vendor_entity_mismatch, vendor_name="ArmCloud International", expected_entity="ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd"

sam_partnerships: PO 2026-AC-7789. Uploaded screenshot from the portal here: https://redwood.internal/links/po-2026-AC-7789-scrn

claire_marketplaceops: Marketplace requires exact match between invoicing entity and our vendor alias registry. We can create an alias mapping but procurement/audit requires a signed vendor alias amendment for records. Without it, ingestion rejects automatically.

leo_arm: Leo from ArmCloud here. Our APAC legal entity is separate. We can sign an alias confirmation letter, but counsel turnaround is usually 48-72h. Is there any interim path to unblock the customer?

raj_legal: We can draft a short amendment that only authorizes the billing alias and does not alter commercial terms or IP language. That should be low risk and quick to sign. I'll prepare a one-paragraph amendment and share with ArmCloud counsel.

gabe_sales: Customer timeline is EOW. If legal can get amendment out today sales will push on procurement. Otherwise we may need to accept a manual invoice and backfill the PO, which is messy for revenue recognition.

anita_finance: Manual invoice is an option but last resort. Prefer to keep marketplace flow for automated accounting. If legal sends amendment today and procurement signs, finance can update vendor alias and re-run ingestion. Need signed doc for audit trail.

claire_marketplaceops: Operationally we can "pre-stage" a mapping in the ingestion service if you give exact alias string and tax id. We then open a temporary exception ticket that allows ingestion to accept PO 2026-AC-7789 pending receipt of the signed amendment. Example payload we need (must be exact casing):

{"po_id":"2026-AC-7789","vendor_alias":"ArmCloud APAC Pty Ltd","billing_entity_tax_id":"APAC-XX-12345","contact_email":"payments@armcloud-apac.com"}

leo_arm: Confirming the alias and tax id above are correct. I'll push our counsel to sign the amendment ASAP. Can Raj drop a template?

raj_legal: Drafted and uploaded a one-paragraph amendment to ticket MP-4521 and just DMed Leo. It's intentionally narrow and vendor-friendly.

marketplace-bot: New ticket created: MP-4521 "Vendor alias pre-stage for PO 2026-AC-7789" assigned to claire_marketplaceops.

sam_partnerships: Plan: Raj drafts amendment -> Leo gets vendor counsel to sign -> Anita confirms alias/tax id and attaches signed doc -> Claire pre-stages mapping and re-runs ingestion -> Gabe updates customer. Fallback: manual invoice if we miss the deadline.

gabe_sales: I'll message the customer and set expectations. If they push for an earlier workaround, I'll request manual invoice approval.

claire_marketplaceops: Adding ingestion logs to MP-4521 and will coordinate with eng for a manual override if needed. Once pre-stage is done I'll change ticket status to awaiting_ingest_replay.

anita_finance: Please add me to MP-4521 when the signed amendment is uploaded. I need it for audit and to trigger vendor alias update.

leo_arm: Thanks all — prioritizing with counsel. Will report back within 24h or sooner if signed.

sam_partnerships: Ping here when signed or if counsel requests any language changes.

marketplace-bot: MP-4521 status updated: in_progress -> awaiting_vendor_signature

claire_marketplaceops: Quick note: if ingestion still fails after alias update, we'll capture the marketplace webhook payload and loop infra, but that's last resort.
